programSnapshot.claimScope: Offline mechanism and reliability evidence only. No accuracy, generalization, reduced-effort, benchmark-superiority, or clinical-performance claim.

researchFrame.mainContribution: Reusable, traceable, leakage-aware human judgment for AI-assisted variability assessment, integrated as a non-destructive layer around the preserved VEGO-AI baseline.

evaluationResearchQuestions.question: Where, and in which error categories, does the frozen Agent 4 baseline disagree with independent expert judgment?
Do selective review and memory retrieval target expert-identified baseline problems with traceable and scope-correct evidence?
evidenceRequired: Retrieval relevance, scope, and conflict audit

evaluationResearchQuestions.question: Does a frozen deterministic parallel policy produce positive net correction on unseen, leakage-safe data while preserving baseline safety?
evidenceRequired: External education-domain replication with at least 30 rows

hypotheses.statement: Selective review identifies a non-trivial subset of patterns that contains expert-confirmed baseline errors.
hypotheses.test: EXP-021 and EXP-022 routing precision/recall on adjudicated development labels.

hypotheses.statement: Human judgment memory retrieves relevant, scope-correct prior judgments for new review contexts.
hypotheses.test: EXP-022 blind relevance, scope, conflict, and leakage audit.

hypotheses.statement: A frozen deterministic parallel policy yields positive net correction on unseen leakage-safe expert-labeled data.
hypotheses.test: EXP-024 pilot followed by EXP-025 preregistered external paired comparison.

hypotheses.statement: Reusable memory reduces repeated human review effort without reducing escalation quality.

traceability.metricOrGate: Adjudicated baseline errors and error taxonomy
Paired net correction after policy freeze
Review routing contains adjudicated baseline errors
Blind relevance, scope, conflict, and leakage audit
Positive paired net correction on unseen safe data

baselines.name: Frozen original VEGO-AI baseline
baselines.purpose: Preserve the official Agent 4 output as the immutable comparator.
baselines.data: 179 student models aggregated into 27 Agent 4 patterns.
baselines.evaluationGate: Byte and provenance integrity checks must pass.
baselines.allowedClaim: The original baseline is preserved and reproducibly identifiable.

baselines.name: Current reusable-human-judgment mechanism
baselines.purpose: Demonstrate selective review, structured feedback, memory, advice, and comparison.
baselines.data: 11 review items, 3 reusable judgments, 8 advice items, and 27 comparison rows.
baselines.allowedClaim: Mechanism readiness, traceability, escalation, and baseline protection.

baselines.name: Independent expert-labeled baseline
baselines.purpose: Measure Agent 4 performance against independent adjudicated labels.
baselines.policy: No candidate policy; characterize B0 only.
baselines.evaluationGate: At least 20 safe labels for quantitative reporting; 16 development and 8 sealed holdout.
baselines.allowedClaim: No accuracy result until the gate opens.

baselines.name: Frozen deterministic candidate policy
baselines.purpose: Define one development-only parallel correction proposal if evidence warrants it.
baselines.data: Development labels only; sealed holdout remains unread.
baselines.evaluationGate: At least three correctable development errors across at least two settings plus supervisor approval.
baselines.allowedClaim: Policy design rationale only; no performance claim.

baselines.name: Sealed holdout pilot
baselines.purpose: Evaluate one frozen candidate exactly once on eight previously sealed rows.
baselines.data: Eight rows selected before policy development.
baselines.evaluationGate: One-time run, no post-hoc policy revision.
baselines.allowedClaim: Pilot evidence only, regardless of direction.

baselines.name: External education-domain replication
baselines.purpose: Test the frozen policy on a newly collected education-domain batch.
baselines.policy: B3 remains frozen; no external-set tuning.
baselines.evaluationGate: Preregistered paired statistics, macro-F1 non-decline, and subgroup safety.
baselines.allowedClaim: Formal improvement only if every preregistered criterion passes.

studentModels.claimBoundary: Scale description only; not an independently labeled evaluation sample.

agent4Patterns.claimBoundary: Frozen baseline distribution, not expert ground truth.

reviewItems.claimBoundary: Observed prototype count; it is not a demonstrated effort reduction.

reusableJudgments.claimBoundary: All three are same-pattern mechanism evidence and excluded from generalization metrics.

memoryAdviceItems.claimBoundary: Retrieval availability only; independent relevance is pending EXP-022.

memoryInformedChanges.claimBoundary: Current policy cannot produce an accuracy delta because it changes no classifications.

reviewAfterMemory.claimBoundary: Escalation mechanism evidence; precision and recall await expert labels.

latestIteration.claimBoundary: Reliability-only NEUTRAL snapshot; no performance default or accuracy claim.

labelGate.humanActionRequired: Approve the protocol, complete two independent blind reviews, adjudicate disagreements, and freeze the gold labels.

experiments.title: Reviewer calibration without evaluation leakage
experiments.question: Can two reviewers apply the protocol consistently before the blinded evaluation begins?
inputs: Three same-pattern rows excluded from every generalization metric
Reviewer instructions and approved label vocabulary
outputs: Clarified protocol revision with no labels transferred to evaluation
acceptance: Both reviewers complete all three rows independently
Every disagreement is discussed and recorded
Calibration rows remain excluded from EXP-020 through EXP-025 metrics
experiments.claimBoundary: Calibration checks protocol usability only; it is not evidence of classification performance or generalization.

experiments.title: Independent expert labeling of the 24 safe candidates
experiments.question: What independent gold labels do two reviewers and an adjudicator assign to the current leakage-safe candidate set?
acceptance: No AI or memory-derived label is shown to reviewers
All required rationale, confidence, reviewer, and date fields validate
Disagreements are adjudicated without modifying raw reviewer returns
experiments.claimBoundary: At 1-19 safe labels results are pilot-only; at 20-24 quantitative reporting is allowed only with explicit small-sample limitations.

experiments.title: Development-only baseline error characterization
experiments.question: Where does the frozen Agent 4 baseline disagree with adjudicated experts on the 16-row development partition?
outputs: Candidate cases where advice might have helped
acceptance: The sealed eight-row holdout remains unread
Every error category has a human rationale and source row
No policy rule is selected inside this experiment
dependencies: EXP-020 has at least 20 safe adjudicated labels
experiments.claimBoundary: Development errors characterize the current sample; they do not establish holdout or cross-domain performance.

experiments.title: Routing and retrieval validity audit
experiments.question: Do review triggers and memory retrieval focus attention on expert-identified baseline problems without hiding missed problems?
outputs: Retrieval hit, relevance, scope, and conflict audit
acceptance: Denominators distinguish patterns, queue items, cases, and review transactions
Every retrieval judgment is made blind to candidate-policy output
Same-pattern reuse is reported separately
experiments.claimBoundary: This evaluates targeting and traceability; it does not by itself prove classification improvement or reduced effort at scale.

experiments.title: Deterministic policy development
experiments.question: Can a frozen deterministic parallel policy be justified from development-only errors without changing the baseline?
inputs: At least three correctable development errors across at least two settings
outputs: One frozen candidate for holdout evaluation
acceptance: Rules use no sealed-holdout or external labels
Every fallback preserves the baseline and requests or parks human review
Output remains parallel_proposal_only
dependencies: At least three development errors across two settings
experiments.claimBoundary: Policy development is proposal-only and cannot authorize Agent 4, runtime, or baseline changes.

experiments.title: One-time sealed eight-row holdout pilot
experiments.question: Does the frozen policy produce positive net correction on eight previously sealed rows without a harmful regression?
inputs: Adjudicated holdout labels opened only after policy freeze
acceptance: Holdout is opened once after policy freeze
No post-hoc policy change is made after viewing holdout outcomes
All baseline and protected-path hashes remain unchanged
dependencies: EXP-023 frozen and approved for one-time holdout evaluation
experiments.claimBoundary: Eight rows support a pilot decision only; they are too small for a formal improvement or generalization claim.

experiments.title: External education-domain replication
experiments.question: Does a policy frozen before data collection retain a positive paired effect on a new education-domain batch?
inputs: At least 30, target 48, new independently labeled patterns
outputs: Bootstrap confidence interval and exact McNemar test
Setting and class subgroup safety analysis
acceptance: Minimum external N is 30; target N is 48
Net-correction confidence interval excludes zero
Exact McNemar p-value is below 0.05
Macro-F1 does not decline and no predefined subgroup shows harm
experiments.claimBoundary: Only this external gate can support a formal improvement claim, and only if every preregistered criterion passes.

experiments.title: Human-effort and workflow study
experiments.question: Does memory change repeated-review demand, review time, or escalation quality under a controlled reviewer workflow?
acceptance: Task order and carryover effects are controlled
No inferred or fabricated time savings
Results separate local pilot observations from scale claims
experiments.claimBoundary: Reduced human effort is unproven until this controlled study is completed; no scale claim is permitted from queue counts alone.

experiments.title: Ablation and robustness analysis
experiments.question: Which approved mechanism elements are necessary for any observed paired effect and safety behavior?
outputs: Sensitivity to class balance and confidence thresholds
acceptance: Ablations do not tune on the external outcomes
All configurations retain baseline immutability
Negative and null results are reported
experiments.claimBoundary: Ablation supports explanation and robustness only after the primary external analysis; it cannot rescue a failed primary gate.

decisionDependencies.title: Confirm or correct the July 1 record
Approve observation, routing, and dosage parameters
Confirm human authority and implementation boundary
decisionDependencies.unlock: Reviewer roles, policy freeze, and one-time pilot

decisionDependencies.title: Confirm thesis and future-work scope
decisionDependencies.unlock: External education replication and optional effort study

riskGates.risk: Same-pattern leakage could create circular evidence.
riskGates.mitigation: Exclude same-pattern and unknown provenance from primary metrics.

riskGates.risk: The current candidate set is too small for a formal improvement claim.
riskGates.mitigation: Report 20–24 labels as a limited MSc result; require at least 30 new external rows for formal testing.

riskGates.risk: Policy design on all labeled rows would contaminate evaluation.
riskGates.mitigation: Freeze a 16/8 development/holdout partition before policy inspection.

riskGates.risk: One course and two settings cannot establish broader validity.
riskGates.mitigation: Collect a new education-domain batch with a frozen policy and independent reviewers.

primary: Net correction = changed-and-correct minus changed-and-wrong on paired rows
secondary: Retrieval relevance, scope correctness, and conflict rate
safety: Baseline files changed: must remain zero
Protected runtime paths changed: must remain false
Unknown or same-pattern leakage in primary metrics: must remain zero
Automatic correction applications: must remain zero
Post-hoc holdout policy revisions: must remain zero

statisticalProtocol.pairedTest: Exact McNemar on the external set
formalImprovementGate: At least 30 externally collected, generalization-safe, adjudicated labels
Candidate policy frozen before external data inspection
Net-correction 95% paired-bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero
No predefined setting or class subgroup shows material harm
Baseline and protected-path hashes remain unchanged

safeNow: VEGO-AI has a reusable human-judgment mechanism supporting selective review, structured feedback, provenance-aware memory, advisory retrieval, and non-destructive comparison.
The current implementation preserves original Agent 4 classifications and baseline artifacts.
The project is evaluation-ready but remains blocked on independent expert input.
conditionalAfterLabels: At 20-24 generalization-safe adjudicated labels, report baseline and candidate metrics as an MSc pilot with explicit small-sample limitations.
At eight sealed holdout rows, report one-time pilot net correction without a formal improvement claim.
formalImprovement: A formal improvement claim requires EXP-025 and every preregistered statistical and safety criterion to pass.
notAllowed: Guaranteed or proven accuracy improvement at the current zero-label state
Benchmark superiority using analysis files that duplicate Agent 4 output
Reduced human effort at scale without EXP-026
Clinical performance or domain transfer claims
Automatic baseline mutation, Agent 4 changes, or M4B-2 authorization
